title: Local TV ad cost: broadcast, cable and streaming

facts.fact: National Media Spots lists local broadcast TV at $500 to $10,000 per month, dated June 13, 2026.
facts.quote: Local broadcast TV | $500 to $10,000 | Per month | National Media Spots | June 13, 2026

facts.fact: National Media Spots lists regional cable TV at $1,000 to $20,000 per month, dated June 13, 2026.
facts.quote: Regional cable TV | $1,000 to $20,000 | Per month | National Media Spots | June 13, 2026

facts.fact: National Media Spots lists streaming/CTV at $500 to $50,000+ per month, dated June 13, 2026.
facts.quote: Streaming/CTV | $500 to $50,000+ | Per month | National Media Spots | June 13, 2026

facts.fact: National Media Spots lists streaming/CTV at $15 to $40+ CPM, dated June 13, 2026.
facts.quote: Streaming/CTV | $15 to $40+ | CPM | National Media Spots | June 13, 2026

facts.fact: Amazon Ads lists TV 30-second spot pricing at $5 to $30 CPM; the page states no date for this figure.
facts.quote: TV, 30-second spot | $5 to $30 | CPM | Amazon Ads | Date not stated

facts.fact: Per Moonb's 2026 guide citing NBC via Bloomberg, a Super Bowl 30-second spot averaged about $8 million in airtime, with some above $10 million.
facts.value: About $8 million average; some above $10 million
facts.quote: About $8 million average, some above $10 million | Per spot, airtime only | NBC via Bloomberg

facts.fact: Comcast Advertising and National Media Spots put a local placement or spot at a few hundred to a few thousand dollars, with the page noting the figure is by market and schedule.
facts.value: A few hundred to a few thousand dollars
facts.quote: A local TV ad cost usually runs from a few hundred dollars to several thousand per airing.

facts.fact: Moonb's 2026 guide puts a simple local TV spot production at $1,500 to $10,000, covering a small crew, one location, one day and a straightforward edit.
facts.quote: Moonb’s 2026 guide puts a simple local spot at $1,500 to $10,000 for production.

facts.fact: Moonb's 2026 guide puts professional mid-range TV commercial production at $10,000 to $50,000.
A Lincoln Library research guide describes the SQAD method: multiply the market's SQAD cost per point by the Nielsen rating of the program airing, which approximates the spot price.
facts.quote: take the SQAD cost per point for the market and multiply it by the Nielsen rating of the program airing at that time.

facts.fact: National Media Spots says prime time, typically 8 to 11 PM, carries the highest local TV rates.
facts.quote: Prime time (typically 8 to 11 PM) carries the highest rates because viewing peaks then.

facts.fact: National Media Spots notes that CTV campaigns can launch on $500 to $1,000 a month.
facts.quote: National Media Spots notes that CTV campaigns can launch on $500 to $1,000 a month.

facts.fact: BIA's September 2026 update puts 2026 local political spending at $9.7 billion, up from $8.4 billion in April.
facts.quote: The September update puts local political spending at $9.7 billion for 2026, up from $8.4 billion in April.

facts.fact: BIA says $1.2 billion of the $1.3 billion increase in local political spending went to TV OTA (broadcast) and TV OTT (streaming).
facts.quote: Of that $1.3 billion increase, BIA says $1.2 billion went to TV OTA (broadcast) and TV OTT (streaming).

facts.fact: BIA's first look at 2027 projects local political spending at about $1.1 billion and total local revenue roughly flat at $186.5 billion.
facts.quote: Its first look at 2027 has political spending falling to about $1.1 billion in the off-cycle year, with total local revenue roughly flat at $186.5 billion.

facts.fact: Adwave's vendor pricing allows daily budgets from $30 to $10,000, paid prepaid with no subscription or contract.
facts.quote: Adwave pricing allows [daily budgets from $30 to $10,000](https://adwave.com/pricing/), prepaid, with no subscription or contract, and campaign creative is included.

facts.fact: Per Adwave's vendor page, TV, Facebook, Instagram and Google (YouTube and Search) open from a $30 daily budget.
facts.quote: TV, Facebook, Instagram and Google (YouTube and Search) open from $30 a day.

facts.fact: Per Adwave's vendor page, Reddit opens from about $35 a day.
facts.quote: Reddit opens from about $35 a day.

facts.fact: Per Adwave's vendor page, extra creative beyond the included set costs $12 per additional 30-second TV spot.
facts.quote: Extra creative beyond the included set has its own price, for example $12 per additional 30-second TV spot.
